# Pathology and volume review

1. Request only the declared slide or volume identifier, approved focus, and
   permitted magnification or modality.
2. Treat returned region and finding identifiers as bounded observations, not
   a diagnosis or a replacement for a qualified clinical review.
3. Preserve uncertainty, check the host-provided review artifact, and request
   a distinct permitted view only when it resolves a specific research gap.
4. Do not request pixels, DICOM files, image paths, or unbounded visual data.
